shared_protocol.sampler: reuse B20 physical-window order; clean/background per physical window; no outcome-dependent resampling
shared_protocol.scheduler: MultiStepLR milestones=[600], gamma=0.1, applied after each update; no reduced-LR update before final
shared_protocol.backend: Math SDPA, Flash and memory-efficient disabled
shared_protocol.action_loss: official unweighted mean L1 over all8x7 valid values
shared_protocol.stage: joint action and auxiliary, no additional RLA-only updates
shared_protocol.randomness: same initial CPU/CUDA/Python/NumPy state and official stochastic graph for C/D; added RLA draws need not reproduce B20 random consumption after step0
shared_protocol.selection: final600 only, no early stopping or budget extension
shared_protocol.memory: same non-reentrant activation checkpointing for B/C/D; expandable allocator, cache release
shared_protocol.initialization: trained original C parameters; reinitialize only layer_norm2_rla and fc2_rla
shared_protocol.keep_loss: masked mean L1(student(training appearance), frozen eval C(same-state clean)); beta0 or1
shared_protocol.numerical_loss_coordinates: official normalized action space; valid 8x7 elements; float32 reduction for keep
shared_protocol.teacher: train observations only; no future frames or sidecars; teacher outputs are not ground truth

appearance_rules: same physical order; clean/background eachonce; no unseen palette training
recovery: full model/optimizer/scheduler/RNG/sample position; stop on CUDA/ECC/nonfinite; preserve attempts, no silent retry

intervention.strategy: new post-training four-arm factorial comparison, not a replacement for historical C/D
intervention.unchanged_action_path: all other C policy parameters, including RLA token trunk and gates
intervention.teacher_input: same physical training state, clean appearance only
